decision: Firmware regression conjunction consistency: six fixed compiler arms of one function/input; a public auditor asks whether licensed timer ranges and adjacent logical clock guards admit one common real-log cost explanation satisfying a conjunction. A true-admission is only feasibility; original N need not be identified and false admissions remain visible.
scope: Actual upstream processor RTL translated by Yosys to CXXRTL and executed, with author-owned reference divider RTL, deterministic host memory, C firmware, and functional oracle. Digital discrete-event reference-design boundary only: no native Hopper/H20, physical clock, silicon, FPGA, PPA, latency/performance evidence, confidentiality, cryptography, necessity or inference resistance. Full debug intentionally reveals N/D. No remote experiment, publication, paper edit or scoring.

functions.array_sum: unsigned32 sum of all eight volatile input words modulo 2^32
functions.xorshift: x=input[0] (replace zero by1); perform exactly24 xorshift32 iterations x^=x<<13; x^=x>>17; x^=x<<5, unsigned32
functions.crc32: c=0xffffffff; for each eight volatile input words use only low byte c^=input[i]&255; exactly8 reflected bit updates c=(c>>1)^((0-(c&1))&0xedb88320); return ~c
functions.popcount: sum of bit counts of all8 words using x&=x-1 until zero, unsigned32
functions.subtractive_gcd: a=(input[0]&1023)+1; b=(input[1]&1023)+1; repeatedly subtract smaller from larger until equal, return a

firmware: Each function compiled separately at all6 flags; two input sets loaded by host into volatile read-only-under-contract words, same binary across inputs. Own freestanding C only, unsigned arithmetic and bounded loops; no library runtime. _start sets sp=0xff00 and gp under norelax, calls main, then ebreak. main writes one32-bit result to MMIO0x10000000 then returns. No division/multiply/extension instructions intended; -march=rv32i -mabi=ilp32. No program/input/flag tuning or selection based on costs/filtering. Preserve duplicate binaries/ties and zeros.

layout.elf: ELF32 little endian RISC-V; parse PT_LOAD to RAM, enforce file/memory bounds, no external objcopy
layout.ram: all bytes zero before ELF loads then fixed input words. Writable RAM excludes firmware [0,8192), inputs[32768,32800); exact aligned word bus with byte strobes for stack. Invalid/out-of-range bus access => source unknown

reference_controller: Separate actual Yosys CXXRTL module, sampled on each reference rising edge. global reset initializes all controller registers and previous_D=1000; command_reset idle latches D, checks positive bounded D and both exact guard cross-products, clears phase/timer/pulses, licenses one start. Two quiet edges at stable cfgD required. start consumes license and sets busy but excludes this edge from timer. Each subsequent busy refedge timer increments by1; when phase=D-1 phase=0,pulse=1,pulses++. Otherwise phase++. D held throughout job; any busy config change invalidates. Driver clocks processor exactly once only after an observed RTL pulse. Upon trap sampled after that CPU edge, driver raises stop for following refedge; stop branch clears busy without incrementing timer. This stop edge lies outside observation. No driver assigns N*D to any RTL timer or reports a formula as an observation.
clock_host_coupling: Reference-design boundary: C++ event scheduler couples observed reference-controller pulse to a low/high processor clock pair; processor clock held low between pulses. Before every CPU rising edge mem_ready=mem_valid for legal mapped bus; mem_rdata=current addressed RAM word, MMIO reads invalid. A valid ready write applies byte strobes on that edge. Memory input settles while core clock low, then high evaluates/commits. Host memory and scheduler are assumed synchronous logical components, not an autonomous synthesized physical clock/RAM/CDC implementation. CPU reset runs8 direct core cycles before command_reset/start, outside timer. Reference reset/command/2quiet/start and finalstop edges are explicitly outside observation; c=0. Firmware startup/result/ebreak handling remain in N, not subtracted.
identity: Let N be actual count of enabled poststart processor rising edges through first trap (not an input to controller). CPU+memory transition and initial state depend on binary/input and core edges, not D or intervening reference edges. Inductively after k observed busy reference edges: timer=k, pulses=floor(k/D), phase=k mod D; CPU state equals the pulse-indexed execution of that same binary/input. First trap after N core edges occurs exactly at k=N*D. Following stop edge preserves timer, so observed T=N*D with c=0. Check per-edge timer/phase/pulse against previous sampled RTL state and core-cycle endpoint invariance across all paths/guards. Result/MMIO and expected ebreak termination are independently checked; absent/multiple result, unexpected trap PC/instruction or timeout invalidates source obligation.
widths: CPU address/data/regs unsigned32, native RV32I arithmetic modulo2^32. Memory addresses always validated before indexing. Controller D/phase/pulses/guard numerator/denominator unsigned32; products explicitly unsigned64; timer unsigned64. Legal D[1,2000], budget numerator/denominator[1,1000], N[1,1000000], N*D<=2000000000<2^31, 64-bit guard products<=2000000, never wrap. Before increment, reject timer==UINT64_MAX or pulses==UINT32_MAX; phase<D. Declared paths D[748,1337], product<=1337000000. If N timeout1e6 occurs no range is licensed. Firmware code fit below8192, stack stays in[8192,65536), inputs8 exact words. Bounds checks are obligations, not a proof for undeclared arbitrary inputs.
